description: 0/0 at x=pi/3 (or similar): rewrite a linear combination a*sin x + b*cos x via the angle-addition identity as R*sin(x - phi), then apply the sinc limit.

exercises.technique: 0/0 at x=pi/3. Rewrite the linear combination sin x - sqrt3 cos x as 2 sin(x-pi/3) (angle-addition identity), and note pi-3x = -3(x-pi/3). Substitute t=x-pi/3 and apply the sinc limit sin t/t → 1.
0/0 at x=pi/3. Rewrite sin x - sqrt3 cos x as 2 sin(x-pi/3) (angle-addition identity), giving t/(2 sin t) with t=x-pi/3, then apply the sinc limit t/sin t → 1.
